paragraphs.text: Jarin was the war chief of the Ghestos tribe of the Fallaji Empire under Mishra .

Jarin, while a capable tactician, did not trust Ashnod because she was a woman, and with red hair besides. During Ashnod's campaign into Korlis , Jarin disobeyed her direct orders, claiming he did not see the signal flag. This resulted in the Ambush in the Kher Ridges being a complete loss for Mishra , with all of Ashnod's transmogrants lost to the enemy's clay statues and Yotian soldiers .
